note: Action card slots (DR-1, DR-3). Effect amount = die total x mult + add. A slot takes up to max_dice dice and fires with at least min_dice. accepts: pair and three_kind match the first die, run needs consecutive numbers, sum_at_least takes any die and needs a total of at least min. A persists slot that is complete at the end of a turn stays open for the rest of the room and takes no more dice; its dice go back to the hand and roll again. Effects: damage, block and heal by the amount; resource pays the amount of `resource` into the haul; open does nothing but count as open (a rescue cage lock). `resource` is empty unless the effect is resource. Placeholder numbers, tuned with the bot.

items.name: Strike
items.text: Deal damage equal to the die.

items.name: Guard
items.text: Low die (1-4): gain block equal to the die + 1.

items.name: Pair Bet
items.text: Two dice showing the same number: deal their total x 2.

items.name: Small lock
items.text: Any die: driftwood equal to the die.

items.name: Pearl lock
items.text: Two dice showing the same number: 2 pearls.

items.name: Jackpot lock
items.text: Three dice showing the same number: 1 koban coin.

items.name: Soak
items.text: Up to two dice: heal by their total.

items.name: Sum lock
items.text: Two or three dice totalling 10 or more.

items.name: Pair lock

items.name: Run lock
items.text: Three dice in a row, like 3, 4, 5.
